subject: Clippership Connector Access and Safety
overview: The commission welcomed new members, reviewed its procedural goals, and focused on access improvements and safety signage for the newly opened Clippership Connector. Members authorized the purchase of educational guides and formed a working group to replenish public outreach supplies.

items.title: Guest Introduction and Agenda Modification
items.summary: The commission moved the fall bike ride presentation forward to accommodate a guest speaker.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the June minutes following a correction of the attendance record.

items.title: Announcements
items.summary: Announced the official opening of the Clippership Connector and city approval of the Riverside Avenue contraflow lane.

items.title: Fall Family Bike Ride
items.summary: Paul Morgan presented plans for an October 19 Halloween-themed ride to promote the Clippership Connector and requested volunteer marshals.

items.title: Farmers Market and Outreach Working Group
items.summary: Approved the creation of a working group to replenish low outreach supplies and research new promotional materials.

items.title: Hormel Stadium and Police Working Group Updates
items.summary: Noted the Hormel Commission has not yet met to discuss bicycle access, while the police working group discussed requesting recurring bicycle patrols and officer safety training.

items.title: Bike Lights and Educational Materials
items.summary: Approved the purchase of 500 League of American Bicyclists guides for $625 and discussed seeking additional corporate sponsorships.

items.title: Helmet Distribution Program
items.summary: Discussed resuming the helmet giveaway program through Project KidSafe and identified potential storage and distribution partners.

items.title: Clippership Connector Access and Wayfinding
items.summary: Discussed pushing back against 'cyclists dismount' signs and tasked Bruce Kulik with drafting recommendations for temporary wayfinding signage through Medford Square.

items.title: Commission Orientation and Goals
items.summary: Reviewed the body's advisory role, legal requirements for new members, and the chair's objectives regarding bike rack installations and department liaisoning.
